# The tab overflow plugin throws where there is no layout to measure

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

neomjs.com renders its routes on a server before it serves them, and there is no layout there: a stand-in answers every `Neo.main.DomAccess` call with an empty object. On every route that renders a tab header, the tab overflow plugin then logs:

```
Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow: project() threw against a live owner TypeError: rects.shift is not a function
```

The scheduled site build of 2026-11-17 23:47 UTC logged this line 1,426 times. The pages still render, because the error is caught, but the line buries every real error in that log.

## The Problem

`project()` (`src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs:872`) measures with `owner.getLayoutRect(ids)` and reads the answer as a list. In a browser it always is one: `Neo.main.DomAccess.getLayoutRect` maps an array of ids to an array of rects (`src/main/DomAccess.mjs:578`). Without a layout the answer is one object, and `Neo.component.Base#getLayoutRect` (`src/component/Base.mjs:1559`) returns it as a single `Neo.util.Rectangle`. The first measure (`:986`) reads it by index and silently gets nothing; the second (`:1022`) calls `rects.shift()` at `:1029` and throws.

## The Architectural Reality

- The catch at `:1147` names the one expected failure ("getLayoutRect losing a race with teardown is the ONE expected failure") and logs everything else as a defect ("a throw against a LIVE owner is a programming defect"). A measure with no layout is neither: nothing went wrong, and there is nothing to project.
- The `finally` at `:1163` always releases the `measuring` latch.
- `test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs` has a lean owner stub with a replaceable `getLayoutRect`: `createPlugin(getLayoutRect)` at `:163`. The plugin projects once while it is constructed, so capture `console.error` before calling `createPlugin`; the test at `:208` shows the capture.

## The Fix

In `project()`, when an `owner.getLayoutRect(ids)` call answers anything other than an array, leave the pass without projecting: apply no split, log nothing, and let the existing `finally` release the latch. Leave only after the measure reveal at `:1024`–`:1027` has been switched off again. Add a sentence to `project()`'s JSDoc saying that a measure without layout skips the pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: When `owner.getLayoutRect(ids)` resolves anything other than an array, `project()` resolves without throwing and without calling `console.error`; `measuring` is `false` afterwards, and no tab button is hidden or moved into the overflow menu.
- [ ] AC-2: A new test in `Overflow.spec.mjs`, built on `createPlugin(async () => ({}))`, checks AC-1 and fails on `dev` without the fix (paste that failure into the pull request).
- [ ] AC-3: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] AC-4 (post-release, maintainer): the first site build on an engine release with the fix logs no `rects.shift is not a function`.

## Out of Scope

- The server-side stand-in that answers `{}`: it belongs to the site's renderer, which is not in this repository.
- The return shape of `Neo.component.Base#getLayoutRect`, which other callers read too (for example `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/DockSplitter.mjs:249`).
- The `/news/discussions` render failure in the same log.

## Avoided Traps

- **Detecting server-side rendering by a config flag.** The stand-in sets flags meant for unit tests, and `project()` already holds the fact it needs: the shape of the answer.
- **Dropping the catch's `console.error`.** It reports real defects against a live owner and stays.
